note: 三只熊之一,见 Pete.json 的说明。

messages.raw: §fWhy don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
messages.text: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
messages.zh: 何不到火边来,随便找个地方坐下

messages.raw: §fThere was once a baby bear, little and cute,
messages.text: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,
messages.zh: 从前有一只小熊崽,又小又可爱,

messages.raw: §fbut the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"
messages.text: but the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"
messages.zh: 可小熊崽受够了,说了句“该我上场了!”

messages.raw: §fshe found an empty cabin, rusty and old,
messages.text: she found an empty cabin, rusty and old,
messages.zh: 她找到一间空木屋,又旧又生锈,

messages.raw: §fand threw some wood and watched the fire unfold
messages.text: and threw some wood and watched the fire unfold
messages.zh: 扔了几块柴进去,看着火苗窜起来

messages.raw: §fhe got up and looked deep down the darkness
messages.text: he got up and looked deep down the darkness
messages.zh: 他站起身,朝那片黑暗深处望去
